reason: The plugin is a web UI utility that provides an Esc key shortcut to cancel a running turn in DeepSeek Harness, matching its stated UX goal in the README and manifest. Primary behavior is local interaction automation within the composer context, so it is classified as a general utility rather than data, automation orchestration, or external-service tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的按键工具插件，在会话运行中按 Esc 可取消当前回合并与停止按钮走同一取消路径。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI keyboard utility plugin that lets users press Esc to cancel the currently running turn using the same cancel path as the Stop action.

capabilities: Registers an Esc key listener in the web conversation composer context when a turn is running.
Invokes the platform session-cancel action for the active session.
Scoped to the DeepSeek Harness web client and does not declare external service integrations.

reasons.code: README: "Press Esc while the agent is running to cancel the current turn" and implementation note describes calling Session.cancel() from capture keydown handling.
Package manifest sets dsh.client.platform to "web", indicating browser-side plugin behavior only.
Repository metadata focuses on UX and keybinding (topics include esc, keybinding, web-ui), with no API integrations or data-processing features described.
